name: carton
title: Carton
description: For removals and storage firms: a slate-blue transit blanket stitched in zigzag, on which every service is a kraft removal box under a strip of red-and-white FRAGILE tape, the job printed in its ROOM panel, what the price covers ruled as CONTENTS, and the price on the box's end.

tokens.--font-display: headings, business name, menu, tape and printed labels (heavy capitals)
tokens.--font-body: body text and the description on each box
tokens.--font-mono: prices, phone numbers, e-mail addresses, contents lines, dates and code
tokens.--text-xs: smallest lettering: menu, call button word, tape, printed labels, table headings
tokens.--text-s: small text: box descriptions and contents, call box facts, footer, three-column tables on a phone
tokens.--text-m: body size, tables, the call button number, box prices
tokens.--text-l: business name, box titles, standfirsts, customer quotes, sub-headings
tokens.--text-xl: section headings in the text, and the price and arrows on a service page
tokens.--leading-tight: line spacing of page titles and the business name
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the menu, the word on the call button and the smallest headings
tokens.--color-text: text and headings on the blanket, and the keyboard focus ring there
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text on the blanket: back links, dates, page numbers, footer
tokens.--color-accent: link underlines and list bullets on the blanket, and the bar under the current menu item
tokens.--color-stitch: the zigzag stitch used as a rule: under the header, above the footer, between sections
tokens.--color-quilt: the faint zigzag quilting rows across the background on wide screens
tokens.--color-kraft: box faces and the call box (kraft board), and the lettering of the small black labels
tokens.--color-kraft-end: the end of each box, where the price is printed
tokens.--color-print: everything printed on board and white labels: text, panel lines, labels, arrows, hand-holes, focus ring
tokens.--color-tape: the FRAGILE tape, the call button, the tape on a quote, link underlines in tables and quotes
tokens.--color-label: tape lettering and stripes, call button text, and the white of quotes, tables and photo borders
tokens.--color-shade: the shadow under boxes, quotes and tables, the dark inside of the hand-holes, and the ground of code
tokens.--measure: widest a column of text may get
tokens.--box-min: narrowest a box may get before the row drops a column
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: shadow depth under boxes, photo borders
tokens.--space-2: small gap: padding in printed panels, under headings, a box edge to its panel
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: page margin, padding inside boxes, between boxes, between paragraphs
tokens.--space-4: gap between sections, and between the text and the call box
tokens.--space-5: space above the footer, and above the call box under a list
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of boxes, quotes and code
tokens.--print-rule: thickness of the printed panel lines and the rule under table headings
tokens.--quilt: distance between quilting rows on the background
tokens.--ruled: distance between the ruled lines under CONTENTS
tokens.--focus-width: thickness of the keyboard focus ring
